title: Prove exact six-call nonunit fanout on a directed cycle (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact price **six** for demand `(2,1,1)` over `Z/4` when `E_10`, `E_21`, `E_02` and `P_0` cost one and every other directed gate type costs 100. This resolves the concrete cheap-cycle case in lee-phys [#5163](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5163), Open next question 1. The source is preserved and every original dirty input is restored. All nonzero coefficients, arbitrary interleavings and repetitions are allowed, with no workspace or free basis changes.

```text
E_21(-1), E_10(-1), P_0(1), E_10(1), P_0(1), E_21(1)
(a,b,c,p) -> (a+2p,b+p,c+p,p)
```

Claim type: **scoped written proof with an exact finite certificate**. The new word adapts child-first preparation to separated source insertions. A written incoming-row/unit-insertion argument excludes every cheaper word at every positive vector width. The finite certificate independently excludes all words of length at most five. No new kappa, physical caller, full multiplication theorem or selected-frontier change is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit lee-phys #5163 for the question, destination-price theorem and unit-arrival argument; Krzysztof Wójt #5045 for nonunit source counts and repeated-insertion constructions; Ross Richardson #3121/#3063 for edge-priced forest synthesis and dirt restoration; Nick Petalas #4916; Cinna Davis #1944/#1968; Anthony #774; Oscar Fennell #759; Tekalign #3130 and the retained lineage. Predecessor results are cited, not audited or replayed as this contribution. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

Before: #5163 solves destination-only prices and explicitly leaves independently priced directed edges open. After: one suggested cheap-cycle instance has a complete attaining word, a universal lower-bound proof and an exact short-word exclusion.

Local warning-strict normal and optimized CPython checks both pass:

- Complete radius-two/radius-three balls contain 99 and 613 original-dirt/source matrices and have empty intersection. All twelve cheap nonzero-coefficient gates are present, including every inverse.
- A separate scalar interpreter checks all 256 four-scalar inputs and inverse executions. Nineteen controls reject six deleted calls, six wrong signs, invalid gates and capacity excess. All nine directed gate-type prices are checked.
- Each registered command takes about 0.022 seconds locally against its 120-second limit. Both registered commands and package metadata/source pins pass. Generated stdout receipts bind all six package files to SHA256 hashes.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at `2d215b3748c3bec4ccd7984c4da5e172c54844e6`. Official export integrity/input coverage and both read-only Git-free normal/optimized replays pass; all seven export files remain unchanged.

From the contribution checkout root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/z4-directed-cycle-fanout/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/z4-directed-cycle-fanout/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-directed-cycle-fanout
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/z4-directed-cycle-fanout --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 installation can replace that local interpreter. Only the standard library is needed. Expected markers are `PASS_Z4_DIRECTED_CYCLE_FANOUT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Only this fixed abstract price matrix is solved. The full directed-price envelope, physical coefficient preparation, source access, routing, native frames, precision/tape, storage and supplier/outer admission remain open or unpriced. No Lean, Docker or selected scientific cold replay was run. Every registered command ran locally; no mathematical check is deferred solely to CI.

Scientific base is freshly fetched canonical main `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`, priority revision eight, unchanged at submission refresh. TASK.json explicitly changes `bit-helper-contract` to this algebraic side question. The [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19219070), live fanout thread, open/all-state account and topic searches, batch reservations and all-main README searches were checked. Entry cache coverage was 310 open PRs and 5,456 Discussion records. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain outside novelty coverage.

## Open next questions

- Determine the complete directed-price envelope for this demand. Start with directional subset cuts and a Pareto search; the missing obligation is an all-price lower-bound classification.
- Price one physical realization. Start with coefficient access, routing, native frames and restoration; a complete physical caller and tariff contract is missing.

## Related open work

- #1865 studies commuting shared-source C3 fanout intervals in a fixed scalar word. This PR solves a `Z/4` independently directed abstract tariff; no shared word profile or kappa is compared.
- #3120 studies copied-information rank of the selected centre endpoint. This PR computes no centre rank and supplies no selected physical caller.
- #3147 studies centre incidence, sink duality and sharing ceilings. Its native object and invoice differ from this three-row ring-valued tariff; no shared numerical quantity is compared.

- #5935 proves a connected-restoration lower bound for source-XOR words over fields. This PR has a preserved source, a nonidentity fanout endpoint and nonunit coefficients over `Z/4`; it computes no shared numerical quantity.

The completion refresh inspected all 13 other open PRs from this account created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this independently priced `Z/4` demand or computes its minimum. No additional mathematical computations were run to compare those contributions.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six new files in one opt-in research package; no shared implementations, predecessor credits, frozen inputs or selected records change.
